The Big Questions Anu and Kabir were playing in the park when they saw their neighbour, Geeta Aunty, getting out of a taxi.
She was returning home from work and was in her uniform.
A pilot in the Indian Air Force, she is the pride of the whole town.
Kabir, Aunty’s uniform looks a lot like the one I saw at your house yesterday, but the colour is different.
